remarks: Multiple offers, The seller is requesting final and best offers no later than Noon, Wednesday, May 1st. Welcome to your renovated 2-bedroom corner condo in Mid City Stamford! This urban retreat boasts modern luxury and convenience, just steps from Scalzi Park with balcony views of the Rippowam River. Inside, discover a sunlit open floor plan with high-end finishes and a chef's kitchen. Relax in the serene master suite or versatile second bedroom/home office. Enjoy morning coffee on your private balcony overlooking the river.  With reserved parking, in-unit laundry, and pet-friendly policies, this condo offers comfort and convenience. Don't miss this opportunity for city living at its finest!
